reason: It's a brand new name and I haven't seen a single TikTok unboxing or heard from a friend who got their order, so I'm not sending money up front to people I don't know. Also most of what I want is small cheap stuff, and paying 13,000 a kilo plus 5,000 delivery on a 10,000 dinar lipstick or top makes no sense.
objection: Who are these people? No reviews, no videos of real orders arriving, and I pay first and wait 3 weeks. And the per-kilo shipping kills the small cheap items I actually buy.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real unboxing videos from Baghdad girls on TikTok, or a friend getting her order on time, plus a cheaper rate for small light items under a kilo.
